definitions: The inferior extension of the lateral ventricle of the brain, located within the temporal lobe.
A part of the brain's ventricular system, specifically the portion of the lateral ventricle that projects into the temporal lobe.
examples: The temporal horn is a common site for lesions in certain neurological conditions.
Neuroimaging revealed an enlargement of the temporal horn.
Cerebrospinal fluid circulates through the temporal horn.
